license.proof: Upstream file ofl/outfit/Outfit[wght].ttf from the google/fonts repository (version 1.100); OFL.txt shipped beside the font as fonts/outfit/OFL.txt
license.modification: Static Regular (wght=400) instance of the upstream variable font, with the family's own tabular (.tf) digit glyphs baked as the default cmap mapping. Instancing and digit remap only; outlines, spacing, and naming are upstream. No Reserved Font Name is declared by this family, so OFL 1.1 permits the modification and the original name.

review.report: Fonts V1 against AK-fonts S1–S5, B1, K1–K4. S1/K1 geometric sans: Outfit is a geometric sans (near-circular bowls, straight terminals, low contrast; Google Fonts category SANS_SERIF). S2 weight: static instance at wght=400, one Regular family. S3/K2 tabular figures: all ten digits advance 590/1000 em in the shipped file (measured with fontTools); the family's .tf glyphs are the default digit mapping, and rendered string widths agree (10×'1' = 10×'0' at 8/9/10/12/16/20 px). S4 case: lowercase and uppercase Latin present for sentence-case chrome. S5: .ttf imports in Godot 4 as FontFile with no import fix-up. B1: exactly one family for T1/T2. K3 T1/T2 coverage: one Regular face serves clue numbers and chrome/time. K4 clinical fit: neutral, high-contrast, no playful or display features (AES.P1–P3). Readability: clue strings ('1 4 5,1 10 15 20'; personal-best '01:23') legible at 8 px on Paper; no ornament that could muddy a mark (P2/P3). Content limits: no cute, warm, or horror traits. License: OFL 1.1, no Reserved Font Name, OFL.txt shipped with the font; modification recorded in license.modification. No needs-human item.

guidance: Static Regular (wght=400) Outfit with tabular digits as default, for UIS.T1 clue numbers and UIS.T2 chrome/personal-best time. Applying the family to a screen's theme belongs to the screen-owning epics (#93 grid, #94 gallery, #95 result/settings).
